headline_summary: Talen Energy is a Pennsylvania-anchored independent power producer with 13.1 GW of US generation capacity (2.2 GW nuclear including 90% of 2.5 GW Susquehanna, 5.7 GW low/zero-carbon baseload total, 2.8 GW gas combined-cycle from Freedom + Guernsey, 4.6 GW intermediate/peaking, ~800 MW minority coal). FY2025 delivered $1,035M adjusted EBITDA and $524M adjusted FCF. The Amazon AWS PPA signed March 2024 and expanded June 2025 sells up to 1,920 MW carbon-free nuclear baseload through 2042 — among the largest single carbon-free data center PPAs in US history. Pending Cornerstone acquisition + closed Freedom/Guernsey add ~5.3 GW of gas capacity for ~$7.25B total.
headquarters: Houston, Texas (corporate HQ); Pennsylvania-anchored generation fleet
founded: 2015 as PPL Corporation spin-off + Riverstone merchant power combination; emerged from Chapter 11 2023 and re-listed NASDAQ
chairman: Stephen Schaefer (Independent Director; ex-Riverstone, GenOn Holdings board, Golar LNG board)
net_leverage_target: Around 3.5x or lower over the cycle
structural_thesis_in_one_paragraph: Talen Energy is the cleanest pure-play AI electricity exposure in the listed IPP universe: a Susquehanna nuclear anchor at ~$27/MWh LCOE selling to Amazon AWS at hyperscaler-PPA contract prices through 2042, plus a gas-capacity build-out funded with $2.7B of new senior unsecured debt, plus RMR + PJM capacity-market revenue layers. The investment question is whether the AI data center electricity demand cycle sustains long enough for the contracted-revenue layers and the gas-acquisition program to compound into a much larger free-cash-flow base. The board (Schaefer Riverstone+GenOn, Nigro ex-Exelon/Constellation/Blackstone, Horton ex-EFH CFO, Hyde retired Xcel SVP+nuclear DOD, Abbas ex-Apollo/Goldman, Schwartzstein ex-Goldman/Apollo Infrastructure) is calibrated for cycle-management governance through that transition.
